title: An enquiry shows what became of it — Open, Quoted, Won, Lost (by itself) or Dropped (by hand, with a reason)

steps.expect: There is no Status dropdown any more: "Status: Open — Follows its quote, set by itself." Below the form, "Where it stands: Open — no quote yet." with "Drop this enquiry" folded, and "History of this enquiry".
steps.observed: No Status dropdown: "Status Open — Follows its quote — set by itself." Below the form "Where it stands: Open — no quote yet." with "Drop this inquiry" folded, and "History of this inquiry" (the test copy says "inquiry" where the test says "enquiry").

steps.do: Back on the register → on A press "Quote" → add a line → save.
steps.observed: Pressed "Quote" on INQ-00001, added one line, saved (Q-00001). The register shows INQ-00001 "Quoted".

steps.do: [Marketing Manager] approve it; [Marketing Executive, who prepared it] "✉ Send to client" → later "Mark accepted (won)".
steps.expect: A reads "Won" — nobody touched the enquiry. Its page: "Won — its quote was accepted." and the quote number with "(accepted / closed-won)". History: "… is now won — it follows its quote".
steps.observed: Test MktMgr approved, but Test MktExec, who prepared it, could not send it — only MASTER_ADMIN could. After sending and "Mark accepted (won)" the enquiry follows by itself: register "Won"; its page "Won — its quote was accepted. Quote: Q-00001 (accepted / closed-won)"; history "INQ-00001 is now won — it follows its quote".

steps.do: Raise a quotation for B, send it, then "Mark lost" with a reason.
steps.expect: B reads "Lost". (Expired — no answer within its validity — also reads "Lost".)
steps.observed: Quotation Q-00002 sent (by MASTER_ADMIN) then "Mark lost" with a reason: B reads "Lost". A third enquiry whose sent quotation passed its 30-day validity (daily sweep) also reads "Lost".

steps.do: Raise a second quotation for B and send it.
steps.expect: B reads "Quoted" again: one lost quotation does not end it while another is out. If that one is accepted, B reads "Won".

steps.do: New enquiry C "Lab test — outside scope" → open it → "Drop this enquiry" → Why: "We declined to quote", Note "Not our scope" → "Drop it".
steps.expect: "… dropped — we declined to quote." Where it stands: "Dropped — closed without a quote. We declined to quote — Not our scope · by <you>, <date>", with "Reopen it". In the register, hovering "Dropped" shows the reason; there is no "Quote" button on it.
steps.observed: Message "INQ-00004 dropped — we declined to quote.". Where it stands: "Dropped Dropped — closed without a quote. We declined to quote — Not our scope · by Test MktExec, 15 Nov 2026 Reopen it …" with "Reopen it". In the register "Dropped" shows "We declined to quote" on hover, and there is no Quote button.

steps.expect: "… is open again." Status Open, the reason cleared. The history keeps both steps.
steps.observed: Message "INQ-00004 is open again."; status Open, reason and note cleared; history keeps "dropped by Test MktExec — We declined to quote" and "reopened by Test MktExec".

steps.do: NEGATIVE · Drop without picking a reason.
steps.expect: The form will not send; a forced send is refused: "Say why it is dropped — pick a reason."
steps.observed: The "Why" box is required — the browser keeps the form ("Please select an item in the list."); a forced send is refused: "Say why it is dropped — pick a reason.". Still Open.

steps.do: NEGATIVE · Open A (it has a quotation) and look for "Drop this enquiry".
steps.expect: Not offered: "With a quote raised, this follows the quote. If the work is not coming, mark the quote lost." A forced drop is refused the same way.
steps.observed: Not offered on A: "With a quote raised, this follows the quote. If the work is not coming, mark the quote lost." A forced drop is refused: "A quote has been raised for INQ-00001, so it follows that quote — mark the quote lost instead.".

steps.do: Look at the four cards at the top of the register (this year).
steps.expect: Enquiries (with how many are still open) · Quoted (% of enquiries, how many awaiting an answer) · Won (% of enquiries that became orders) · Lost · Dropped (with the hit rate = won ÷ (won + lost)). Each card opens the list filtered to that status. Change the year or search — the cards follow.
steps.observed: Cards: 📨 ENQUIRIES 4 1 open, not quoted yet || 📝 QUOTED 3 75% of enquiries · 0 awaiting an answer || 🏆 WON 1 25% of enquiries became orders || 📉 LOST · DROPPED 2 · 0 Hit rate 33% of decided quotes. Opening each: ENQUIRIES 4 → /inquiries lists 4 (Open/Lost/Won); QUOTED 3 → /inquiries?st=QUOTED_ANY&fy=2026-27 lists 3 (Lost/Won); WON 1 → /inquiries?st=WON&fy=2026-27 lists 1 (Won); LOST · → /inquiries?st=LOST_DROPPED&fy=2026-27 lists 2 (Lost). FY 2027-28 → no cards (nothing that year); search "Valve" → "📨 ENQUIRIES 1 0 open, not quoted yet".
steps.note: The "Lost · Dropped" card opens the Lost list only (?st=LOST); the dropped enquiries are reached through the status filter.

steps.do: EDGE · An enquiry recorded before this update, still reading "Quoted" although its quotation was accepted.
steps.expect: Opening the register (or the enquiry) corrects it to "Won" by itself.
steps.observed: A was set back to the old "Quoted" (its quotation accepted); opening the register corrected it to "Won" by itself.

steps.do: NEGATIVE · New enquiry with "Received date" set to tomorrow (owner, 13 Nov 2026).
steps.expect: The calendar does not go past today. Typed in anyway, a red "⚠ This date is in the future … it will not be saved" appears under the field at once; pressing "Create inquiry" keeps you on the form: "⚠ The received date … is in the future. An enquiry can only be recorded as received today or earlier — it was not saved." Nothing is recorded. Today or an earlier date saves normally.
steps.observed: The calendar stops at today (max 2026-11-15). Tomorrow typed: "Received date ⚠ This date is in the future. An inquiry can only be recorded as received today or earlier — it will not b" at once; "Create inquiry" kept the form with the refusal "⚠ The received date … is in the future … it was not saved." and nothing was recorded. Today saved normally.
steps.note: After the refusal the form's button reads "Save inquiry" instead of "Create inquiry" (the heading still says "New client inquiry") — a small wording slip.

steps.do: EDGE · The status filter on the register.
steps.expect: Lists Open, Quoted, Won, Lost, Dropped. If your company renamed statuses under Admin → lists, your names are kept and Won / Lost still appear.
steps.observed: the filter offers: All statuses, Open, Quoted, Won, Lost, Dropped, Quoted — any outcome, Lost or dropped
